d:
The Gokuldham members gear up for Navratri. Daya conducts garba coaching for the Mahila Mandal, which turns chaotic when Mrs. Hathi and Babita bump heads mid-dance. Meanwhile, Babita asks Jethalal to fetch her special ghungroo dandiyas from Bhuleshwar, which he eagerly agrees to do.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
